referenceSources.description:
An orange Opel Corsa B, modified to Group A kit car specifications, powers through a muddy rural stage, its rear wheels spraying dirt across the track. The hatchback is adorned with sponsor decals such as DEKRA and ACTRONICS, and carries the license plate EA-KC 88. A photographer in the background documents the high-speed maneuver under an overcast sky.

This rally-prepped Corsa B features a 190+ PS engine, Quaife 6-speed dogbox gearbox, ZF multi-plate limited-slip differential, and Proflex adjustable suspension. The recent major overhaul, with only 10 km on the rebuilt motor, underscores its readiness for competitive events.
